title: Requests for Additional Customer Details
summary: The sampled fragments mainly document cases where customers did not provide enough follow-up information, vehicle access, or supporting materials to clarify the issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments describe missing or pending customer details, such as absent explanations, unavailable vehicles, or promised pictures, without enough context to judge sentiment.

limitations: All sampled fragments are undetermined, so there is no evidence here to characterize positive, negative, mixed, or neutral sentiment.
The topic is procedural rather than evaluative, focusing on missing information and follow-up rather than a specific vehicle feature or defect.
Examples are brief and context-limited, so the underlying issue cannot be identified from these fragments alone.
